Definition: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character
BiblicalUsage: 1) elevation, exaltation, dignity, swelling, uprising; 1a) dignity, exaltation, loftiness; 1b) swelling; 1c) uprising
